# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 15: one product per Bohohippychic category end to end (stage 1b FASHN -> stage 2 -> stage 4), export 0.6.0,
# control proxy 0.3.0, prompt 0.3.0, stage 1b QA 0.6.1 (thresholds provisional). At most about $1.63 per product,
# about $8.15 in all (GPU list price, not the invoice); a product stopped after stage 1b costs about $0.03-0.07.
# Needs timeout-minutes 330 in .github/workflows/modal.yml (run 14: 2,311 s wall for one product).
# Order: every export (no GPU) runs before the first GPU command, so a non-GPU failure stops the run before any spend.
# Each modal line ends in `|| echo ::warning::`: a product that fails, or that stage 1b stops before stage 2, does not
# skip the products after it, and the workflow's exit status no longer shows a product failure. Read the warnings
# and each product's cost_summary.json (`stopped_before_stage2`) in the artifact.
# --accept-failed-dress overrides only the provisional silhouette and fidelity checks: a garment-type failure
# (trousers drawn as a skirt, a bodice on a skirt or trousers, an open front drawn closed) stops before stage 2.
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
# azure dress rerun: proxy hem from the 91 cm flat-lay length (run 14's control, proxy 0.1.0, had hem_y 47.6 cm; now 57.3 cm, about 10 cm higher); job azure-palm-baby-doll-dress-de3bc1eeb3e0
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product azure-palm-baby-doll-dress
# top: blouse with half-sleeve shells from the description ("airy half sleeves"); job rosewater-blouse-129498b959df
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-blouse
# trousers: wide-leg palazzo, seat tapered onto two legs with a crotch (no ledge), outseam 99 cm, FASHN label pants, bans skort/overskirt; job rosewater-palazzo-pants-b85affd79b61
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-palazzo-pants
# skirt: maxi A-line from the waistband to above the ankle, no bodice; job crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt-9a2b6e7f37ce
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt
# outerwear: knit cardigan, long sleeves, deep V kept open in the control and in FASHN's edit area; job woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi-56e306f6033b
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/azure-palm-baby-doll-dress --dress --dress-engine fashn --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::azure-palm-baby-doll-dress: run_phase0 failed or stopped before stage 2"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/rosewater-blouse --dress --dress-engine fashn --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::rosewater-blouse: run_phase0 failed or stopped before stage 2"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/rosewater-palazzo-pants --dress --dress-engine fashn --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::rosewater-palazzo-pants: run_phase0 failed or stopped before stage 2"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt --dress --dress-engine fashn --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt: run_phase0 failed or stopped before stage 2"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi --dress --dress-engine fashn --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi: run_phase0 failed or stopped before stage 2"
